chunks: 269 - And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Whoever applies depilatory substances and dyes with henna, Allah, the Exalted, grants him safety from three conditions: leprosy, vitiligo, and al-akilah, until a similar next application."

key_terms.اطَّلَى: applied a depilatory substance to remove hair
key_terms.الْآكِلَةِ: a severe ulcerating or consuming skin disease
key_terms.الْبَرَصِ: vitiligo or a whitening skin disease

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about using depilatory treatment and henna?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes protective benefit to using depilatory treatment and henna dyeing. It reflects the Prophetic sunnah of cleanliness, grooming, and bodily care, while linking such practices to divine protection.
